sentences.en: The children were insistent about our taking them to the movies.
sentences.zh: 孩子们坚持要我们带他们去看电影。

sentences.en: Why are you so insistent on going with me?
sentences.zh: 你为什么一定要和我一起去呢？

sentences.en: The salesman was insistent to the end.
sentences.zh: 那个推销员到最后都还是很坚持。

senses.zh: 坚持的；迫切的；显著的；引人注目的；紧急的
